newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: BASKETBALL-MILIC BECOMES FIRST SLOVENE TO JOIN NBA.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-MILIC BECOMES FIRST SLOVENE TO JOIN NBA.

text.p: Slovenia's Marko Milic has become the tiny Alpine republic's first player to join the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA), Milic's club Olimpija said on Friday.
The 20-year old player, who joined Slovenia's top club in 1994, signed a one-year contract for $250,000 with the Philadelphia 76-ers on Thursday.
Milic, who plays in the position of guard, helped Olimpija to their biggest success in April when they finished third in a EuroLeague competition, behind Greece's Olympiakos and Spain's Barcelona.
